name: PFC Zukowski
role: Private first class, from Newark, New Jersey
summary: A PFC photographed in a white T-shirt and blue jeans in VN-0027: "He was from Newark New Jersey." "He wasn't in my hooch." Larry first gave the name by sound, "Zoo-Cow-Ski," then "Zee-Cow-Ski," and on 2026-09-03, asked to spell it: "Zukowski. I don't know the first name. No one went by first name in the military." He went to the French pool in Cholon with the others: "Ron Tototz, Zukowski and that guy who played the guitar would go here." And he was on the Saigon rooftop: "I was on a bar on a roof with Zukowski, Stanton and there was war going on all around us."
researchNotes: Display name changed 2026-09-14 from PFC "Zekeowski" to Zukowski, the spelling Larry gave letter by letter on 2026-09-03 (data/recollections/2026-09-03-phone-zukowski.json); the slug stays pfc-zekeowski and every rendering stays in aliases. "Zekeowski" was his son's rendering of the sound and is superseded for searching. Searches should lead with Zukowski; the earlier phonetic candidates (Zykowski, Zikowski, Cikowski, Zichowski, Zekowski) are fallbacks. Newark had a large Polish community, so city directories and news archives are viable once a spelling candidate hits.
